scope: Three additional vendored modules read whole/pin verified/syntax parsed. Only _meliaejson imported directly; no GUI/coldshot dependencies loaded.
findings: _meliaejson fails during Python3 module import with AssertionError. Later string handling also uses str.decode/unichr, requiring Python2 semantics.

Custom meliae parser documents restricted flat format; regex finditer does not enforce complete consumption between/after attributes. It must not be used as a general strict JSON validator. No parse calls executed because import failed.
PStats adapter reports cumulative time/parent shares, not wall-clock frame timing. Parent/child attribution comes from loader semantics yet to review.
Coldshot FunctionLineWrapper.key reuses function key for every source line, so distinct lines can collide in consumers keyed by node identity. Static finding.
ModuleAdapter defines label twice, second overrides first; earlier group-specific formatting is unreachable. Syntax success does not establish displayed report behavior.
